title: Vampire Vape Shortz Purple Fusion
description: Purple Fusion from Vampire Vape’s Shortz collection delivers a mouth-watering fruit blast, perfectly balanced across two irresistible flavours. Juicy, ripe grapes dance with the sweet, tropical punch of tangy pineapple for harmonious fusion of flavours. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
